<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the only upfield signals that could correspond to methyl carbons are at 52.24 ppm (typical for an O‑CH₃) and 43.47 ppm (typical for an N‑CH₃). The signal at 38.60 ppm is more consistent with a methylene carbon rather than a methyl. Therefore the molecule contains two CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
